name: 儿童卡通轻音不哭闹吹风机款
description: 轻音低噪不吓宝宝、双档恒温不伤头皮、负离子抚平毛躁

styleLock.backgroundSystem: soft blush pink #F9E3E1 backdrops with deeper pink round alcoves, warm cream #FDF3EC rounded info cards, coral-red gradient panels for emphasis
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm soft studio lighting, gentle front-top key, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte blush pink round podium and smooth cream panel surfaces
styleLock.typography: rounded geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #3B3B3B or coral red #F0564F with a friendly baby-care feel, all copy wrapped in 「」; soft sunshine-yellow #F7C445 reserved for tiny star and sparkle glyph accents
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons in coral red #F0564F, pill-shaped labels, rounded-corner cards
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the product across the set, product never clipped, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cute baby-care appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of soft blush pink background #F9E3E1, warm cream cards #FDF3EC, charcoal text #3B3B3B, coral-red accent #F0564F and soft sunshine-yellow secondary #F7C445 for tiny glyph accents; warm soft studio lighting with a gentle front-top key and soft contact shadows; rounded geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal or coral red; consistent rounded-corner info cards with pill-shaped labels; consistent thin-line icon style in coral red; clean cute product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 11 张儿童卡通吹风机爆款详情切片提炼；已剥离源品牌、卡通狐狸贴图、婴儿面部、原文案数字（温度/辐射值/分贝/线长）与会员二维码水印，产品一律以 {product} 占位；不可验证数据不进入模版，槽位交由 {callout}/{selling_point} 填写；信任镜以出风口工艺与机身材质微距呈现，不生成任何证书徽章。
